Tatedonas's cooking is gaining a reputation for taste.[XENO:n ]

Report back to Hoko.

Pokapoka the gourmet wants to try a rare delicacy.[XENO:n ]
Find unusual ingredients to satisfy his request.

Report back to Pokapoka.

Find the boy named Noporic.
Locate the missing Noporic.
Report to Myxilia.

Report to Myxilia.

Gather the ingredients for the medicine.

Follow her senior's directions to finish the medicine.
Speak to Mefimefi.

Hand the ingredient to Mefimefi.
Return to Nora.

Nora's best friend should recover in no time.

Convince Strojam.
Return to Nora.

Strojam is guzzling Pojics medicine like juice[XENO:n ]

Find a way to save her.

Consult Nora about Strojam's terrible condition,[XENO:n ]

Get the requested item and give it to Strojam.
